faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Prasar Bharati Copy Editor Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Prasar Bharati Copy Editor position is 08-10-2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Copy Editor post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Degree from a recognized University/Institute along with a Post Graduate Diploma in Journalism/Mass Communication, or a Degree in Journalism/Mass Communication. Proficiency in the concerned language is also essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Copy Editor position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Copy Editor post is 35 years. Specific age relaxations are available for certain categories as mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Copy Editor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Copy Editor position will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Copy Editor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Copy Editor post announced under this recruitment drive by Prasar Bharati.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Prasar Bharati Copy Editor Recruitment is entirely online. Candidates must apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Copy Editor role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Copy Editor position typically involves shortlisting of candidates followed by a test and/or interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Copy Editor position is a contractual role. Candidates will be appointed on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article. It is advisable to download and read it thoroughly before applying.
